name: Minecraft | Loxy v2
author: parker@pterodactyl.io
description: Egg Minecraft Java universal da Loxy Systems, preparada para versões legadas e atuais. Suporta múltiplas versões do Java, instalação Paper com fallback Vanilla oficial e startup remoto com otimização automática de memória/JVM.

installation.script:
#!/bin/ash
set -eu

SERVER_DIR="/mnt/server"
TMP_DIR="${SERVER_DIR}/.loxy-minecraft-install"
PROJECT="paper"
USER_AGENT="Loxy Systems Pterodactyl (https://loxy.host)"
SOFTWARE="${SERVER_SOFTWARE:-auto}"
MC_VERSION="${MINECRAFT_VERSION:-latest}"
BUILD="${BUILD_NUMBER:-latest}"
JAR="${SERVER_JARFILE:-server.jar}"

cleanup() {
    rm -rf "${TMP_DIR}"
}
trap cleanup EXIT

rm -rf "${TMP_DIR}"
mkdir -p "${TMP_DIR}" "${SERVER_DIR}"

echo "=================================================="
echo "      Minecraft Installer - Loxy Systems v2"
echo "=================================================="

DOWNLOAD_URL=""
SELECTED_SOFTWARE=""

# URL personalizada sempre tem prioridade.
if [ -n "${DL_PATH:-}" ]; then
    echo "[DOWNLOAD] Usando DL_PATH personalizado."
    DOWNLOAD_URL="$(eval echo "$(echo "${DL_PATH}" | sed -e 's/{{/${/g' -e 's/}}/}/g')")"
    SELECTED_SOFTWARE="custom"
fi

# Tenta Paper primeiro em auto/paper.
if [ -z "${DOWNLOAD_URL}" ] && { [ "${SOFTWARE}" = "auto" ] || [ "${SOFTWARE}" = "paper" ]; }; then
    echo "[PAPER] Consultando API oficial..."

    PROJECT_JSON="$(curl -fsSL --retry 4 --retry-delay 2 \
        --user-agent "${USER_AGENT}" \
        "https://fill.papermc.io/v3/projects/${PROJECT}" 2>/dev/null || true)"

    if [ -n "${PROJECT_JSON}" ]; then
        if [ "${MC_VERSION}" = "latest" ] || [ -z "${MC_VERSION}" ]; then
            PAPER_VERSION="$(printf '%s' "${PROJECT_JSON}" | jq -r '.versions | to_entries | .[0].value[0] // empty')"
        else
            PAPER_VERSION="${MC_VERSION}"
        fi

        VERSION_VALID="$(printf '%s' "${PROJECT_JSON}" | jq -r \
            --arg VERSION "${PAPER_VERSION}" \
            '[.versions[][]] | index($VERSION) != null' 2>/dev/null || echo false)"

        if [ "${VERSION_VALID}" = "true" ]; then
            VERSION_JSON="$(curl -fsSL --retry 4 --retry-delay 2 \
                --user-agent "${USER_AGENT}" \
                "https://fill.papermc.io/v3/projects/${PROJECT}/versions/${PAPER_VERSION}" 2>/dev/null || true)"

            if [ -n "${VERSION_JSON}" ]; then
                if [ "${BUILD}" = "latest" ] || [ -z "${BUILD}" ]; then
                    PAPER_BUILD="$(printf '%s' "${VERSION_JSON}" | jq -r '.builds[0] // empty')"
                else
                    PAPER_BUILD="${BUILD}"
                fi

                BUILD_VALID="$(printf '%s' "${VERSION_JSON}" | jq -r \
                    --arg BUILD "${PAPER_BUILD}" \
                    '[.builds[] | tostring] | index($BUILD) != null' 2>/dev/null || echo false)"

                if [ "${BUILD_VALID}" != "true" ]; then
                    PAPER_BUILD="$(printf '%s' "${VERSION_JSON}" | jq -r '.builds[0] // empty')"
                fi

                if [ -n "${PAPER_BUILD}" ]; then
                    BUILD_JSON="$(curl -fsSL --retry 4 --retry-delay 2 \
                        --user-agent "${USER_AGENT}" \
                        "https://fill.papermc.io/v3/projects/${PROJECT}/versions/${PAPER_VERSION}/builds/${PAPER_BUILD}" 2>/dev/null || true)"

                    DOWNLOAD_URL="$(printf '%s' "${BUILD_JSON}" | jq -r '.downloads."server:default".url // empty' 2>/dev/null || true)"

                    if [ -n "${DOWNLOAD_URL}" ]; then
                        SELECTED_SOFTWARE="paper"
                        MC_VERSION="${PAPER_VERSION}"
                        BUILD="${PAPER_BUILD}"
                        echo "[PAPER] Versao: ${MC_VERSION} | Build: ${BUILD}"
                    fi
                fi
            fi
        fi
    fi

    if [ -z "${DOWNLOAD_URL}" ] && [ "${SOFTWARE}" = "paper" ]; then
        echo "[ERRO] A versao ${MC_VERSION} nao foi encontrada no Paper."
        echo "[ERRO] Use SERVER_SOFTWARE=auto para permitir fallback Vanilla."
        exit 1
    fi
fi

# Fallback oficial Mojang para versões sem build Paper.
if [ -z "${DOWNLOAD_URL}" ] && { [ "${SOFTWARE}" = "auto" ] || [ "${SOFTWARE}" = "vanilla" ]; }; then
    echo "[VANILLA] Consultando manifest oficial da Mojang..."

    MANIFEST="$(curl -fsSL --retry 4 --retry-delay 2 \
        --user-agent "${USER_AGENT}" \
        "https://piston-meta.mojang.com/mc/game/version_manifest_v2.json")"

    if [ "${MC_VERSION}" = "latest" ] || [ -z "${MC_VERSION}" ]; then
        VANILLA_VERSION="$(printf '%s' "${MANIFEST}" | jq -r '.latest.release')"
    else
        VANILLA_VERSION="${MC_VERSION}"
    fi

    VERSION_URL="$(printf '%s' "${MANIFEST}" | jq -r \
        --arg VERSION "${VANILLA_VERSION}" \
        '.versions[] | select(.id == $VERSION) | .url' | head -n1)"

    if [ -z "${VERSION_URL}" ] || [ "${VERSION_URL}" = "null" ]; then
        echo "[ERRO] Minecraft ${VANILLA_VERSION} nao encontrado no manifest oficial."
        exit 1
    fi

    VERSION_META="$(curl -fsSL --retry 4 --retry-delay 2 \
        --user-agent "${USER_AGENT}" \
        "${VERSION_URL}")"

    DOWNLOAD_URL="$(printf '%s' "${VERSION_META}" | jq -r '.downloads.server.url // empty')"

    if [ -z "${DOWNLOAD_URL}" ]; then
        echo "[ERRO] A Mojang nao disponibiliza server.jar para ${VANILLA_VERSION}."
        exit 1
    fi

    SELECTED_SOFTWARE="vanilla"
    MC_VERSION="${VANILLA_VERSION}"
    echo "[VANILLA] Versao: ${MC_VERSION}"
fi

if [ -z "${DOWNLOAD_URL}" ]; then
    echo "[ERRO] Nenhuma URL de download valida foi encontrada."
    exit 1
fi

echo "[DOWNLOAD] Software: ${SELECTED_SOFTWARE}"
echo "[DOWNLOAD] Baixando ${JAR}..."

curl -fL --retry 5 --retry-delay 2 \
    --user-agent "${USER_AGENT}" \
    -o "${TMP_DIR}/${JAR}" \
    "${DOWNLOAD_URL}"

if [ ! -s "${TMP_DIR}/${JAR}" ]; then
    echo "[ERRO] O JAR baixado esta vazio."
    exit 1
fi

# Valida estrutura ZIP/JAR antes de substituir o servidor atual.
if ! unzip -tqq "${TMP_DIR}/${JAR}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "[ERRO] O arquivo baixado nao e um JAR valido."
    exit 1
fi

cd "${SERVER_DIR}"

if [ -f "${JAR}" ]; then
    rm -f "${JAR}.old"
    mv "${JAR}" "${JAR}.old"
fi

mv "${TMP_DIR}/${JAR}" "${SERVER_DIR}/${JAR}"

if [ ! -f "${SERVER_DIR}/server.properties" ]; then
    echo "[CONFIG] Baixando server.properties base..."
    curl -fsSL --retry 3 --retry-delay 2 \
        --user-agent "${USER_AGENT}" \
        -o "${SERVER_DIR}/server.properties" \
        "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pterodactyl/game-eggs/main/minecraft/java/server.properties"
fi

echo "=================================================="
echo " Instalacao concluida."
echo " Software: ${SELECTED_SOFTWARE}"
echo " Minecraft: ${MC_VERSION}"
echo " Jar: ${JAR}"
echo " Startup remoto: LoxyHosting/loxy-game-eggs/minecraft.sh"
echo "=================================================="

variables.description: The name of the server jarfile to run the server with.

variables.name: Download Path
variables.description: A URL to use to download a server.jar rather than the ones in the install script. This is not user viewable.

variables.description: Build do Paper. Use latest para a build mais recente. Ignorado quando o software selecionado for Vanilla.
